paragraphs.source_en: For a long while, neither of them spoke. Oharu bathed Hirotada as tenderly as though she were caring for a child. He sat there without moving. Oharu said, “My lord, can you stand? Your feet…”

units.source_en: For a long while, neither of them spoke.
Oharu bathed Hirotada as tenderly as though she were caring for a child.
units.source_zh: 阿春像侍弄一个孩子一样为广忠洗着。

ja.t: じろぎひとつしなかった。

units.source_en: Oharu said, “My lord, can you stand? Your feet…”
units.source_zh: 阿春道：“城主，您能站起来吗，您的脚⋯⋯”

paragraphs.source_zh: 二人好久都没说话。阿春像侍弄一个孩子一样为广忠洗着。他坐在那里，一动不动。阿春道：“城主，您能站起来吗，您的脚⋯⋯”

paragraphs.source_en: “Oharu.” Hirotada said, “I have made up my mind, and I shall not change it for as long as I live.”

units.source_en: Hirotada said, “I have made up my mind, and I shall not change it for as long as I live.”
units.source_zh: 广忠道，“我已经下定了决心，一辈子不会改变主意。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “阿春。”广忠道，“我已经下定了决心，一辈子不会改变主意。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Tell no one, but I will not go near my newly wedded wife.”

units.source_en: “Tell no one, but I will not go near my newly wedded wife.”
units.source_zh: “休要告诉人，我不会接近新过门的夫人。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “休要告诉人，我不会接近新过门的夫人。”

paragraphs.source_en: “I will prove it to you. But I am not doing this out of spite toward Odai.”

units.source_en: “I will prove it to you. But I am not doing this out of spite toward Odai.”

ja.t: からそうするのではない」

units.source_zh: “我可以做给你看，但这不是跟於大赌气。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “我可以做给你看，但这不是跟於大赌气。”

paragraphs.source_en: Startled, Oharu’s hands fell still. She felt an unusual heat in Hirotada’s hand, and his eyes were gleaming. Oharu felt the same fear and shame she had known on the day Hirotada first took her into his favor. She was Lady Odai’s shadow; Oharu did not deny it. Yet she feared that her resemblance to Lady Odai might bring her into conflict with the new wife.

units.source_zh: 阿春吃了一惊，停下了手。

units.source_en: She felt an unusual heat in Hirotada’s hand, and his eyes were gleaming.
units.source_zh: 她感觉广忠的手有些炽热，双眼也闪闪发光。

units.source_en: Oharu felt the same fear and shame she had known on the day Hirotada first took her into his favor.
units.source_zh: 阿春感到恐惧和羞耻，就跟广忠最初宠幸她那日一样。

units.source_en: She was Lady Odai’s shadow; Oharu did not deny it.
units.source_zh: 她是於大夫人的影子，阿春并不否认这一点。

units.source_en: Yet she feared that her resemblance to Lady Odai might bring her into conflict with the new wife.
units.source_zh: 但是，她却害怕因为有着和於大夫人相似的面孔，而和新夫人发生龃龉。

paragraphs.source_zh: 阿春吃了一惊，停下了手。她感觉广忠的手有些炽热，双眼也闪闪发光。阿春感到恐惧和羞耻，就跟广忠最初宠幸她那日一样。她是於大夫人的影子，阿春并不否认这一点。但是，她却害怕因为有着和於大夫人相似的面孔，而和新夫人发生龃龉。

paragraphs.source_en: Cherry blossoms lay scattered across the floor, and the rich fragrance of flowers filled the air. Oharu pressed her face against Hirotada’s frail chest…

units.source_en: Cherry blossoms lay scattered across the floor, and the rich fragrance of flowers filled the air.
units.source_zh: 地板上落满樱花，周围都是扑鼻的花香。

units.source_en: Oharu pressed her face against Hirotada’s frail chest…
units.source_zh: 阿春将脸贴到广忠瘦弱的胸脯上⋯⋯

paragraphs.source_zh: 地板上落满樱花，周围都是扑鼻的花香。阿春将脸贴到广忠瘦弱的胸脯上⋯⋯
